dialogue.title: Always available?
dialogue.subtitle: Listen and read with your teacher, then examine the views in the conversation

lines.en: Has working from home actually given you more freedom?
lines.pt: Trabalhar de casa realmente te deu mais liberdade?

lines.en: In theory, yes. In practice, I’m snowed under, and work spills over into the evening
lines.pt: Na teoria, sim. Na prática, estou sobrecarregada, e o trabalho invade a noite

lines.en: So flexibility comes at a price. Could clearer boundaries help?
lines.pt: Então a flexibilidade tem um custo. Limites mais claros poderiam ajudar?

lines.en: They would, but constant availability has become the norm. It’s hard to push back
lines.pt: Ajudariam, mas estar sempre disponível virou o padrão. É difícil contestar isso

lines.en: I can see why. Still, blurred boundaries can take a toll, even if you enjoy the work
lines.pt: Entendo o motivo. Ainda assim, limites pouco claros podem causar desgaste, mesmo que você goste do trabalho

lines.en: I struggle to switch off, so I mute notifications after six, except for genuine emergencies
lines.pt: Tenho dificuldade para me desligar, então silencio as notificações depois das seis, exceto em emergências reais

lines.en: That’s a trade-off. But does being available really mean you’re doing good work?
lines.pt: Essa escolha tem seus custos. Mas estar disponível realmente significa que você está fazendo um bom trabalho?

lines.en: Not necessarily. I’d rather agree on expectations than treat quick replies as commitment
lines.pt: Não necessariamente. Prefiro combinar as expectativas em vez de tratar respostas rápidas como comprometimento

questions.prompt: Why hasn’t flexibility translated into more free time for Ana?
questions.answer: Work spills into the evening, and constant availability has become expected

questions.prompt: What boundary has Ana introduced, and what exception does she allow?
questions.answer: She mutes notifications after six, except for genuine emergencies

questions.prompt: What assumption about commitment do they challenge?
questions.answer: That quick replies or constant availability prove someone is doing good work

freeConversationInstruction: Discuss work-life boundaries with your teacher. Explore trade-offs and challenge each other’s assumptions
